name: M3_MMS060MI_Get
description:
Retrieve detailed balance identities for a specific warehouse and item. A balance identity is the unique combination of warehouse, item number, location, lot, container and receiving number together with status, current on-hand quantity and allocated quantity. This operation returns all balance identities that match the supplied warehouse and item, optionally further narrowed by location, lot, container or receiving number. The response includes:

- Identity and description data for company, warehouse and item  
- Status and control information for the item and balance identity  
- On-hand, physical and allocated quantities, including catch weight and potency  
- Key dates such as receipt, issue, inventory, priority and expiry  
- Attribute identifiers, lot references, packaging and automatic-deletion settings

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse for which to retrieve detailed item balance identities.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number for which to retrieve detailed balances in the specified warehouse.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company for which balance identities are retrieved.

inputParameters.name: WHSL
inputParameters.description: Specific warehouse location used to narrow the balance identity search.

inputParameters.name: BANO
inputParameters.description: Lot number used to narrow the balance identity search.

inputParameters.name: CAMU
inputParameters.description: Container number used to narrow the balance identity search.

inputParameters.name: REPN
inputParameters.description: Receiving number used to narrow the balance identity search.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company to which the balance identity belongs.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse where the balance identity is held.

outputParameters.name: WHNM
outputParameters.description: Name or description of the warehouse.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number for the balance identity.

outputParameters.name: ITDS
outputParameters.description: Item name for the balance identity.

outputParameters.name: WHSL
outputParameters.description: Location within the warehouse for the balance identity.

outputParameters.name: BANO
outputParameters.description: Lot number for the balance identity.

outputParameters.name: CAMU
outputParameters.description: Container number for the balance identity.

outputParameters.name: REPN
outputParameters.description: Receiving number associated with the stock receipt for this balance identity.

outputParameters.name: ABCD
outputParameters.description: ABC volume class used to group the item by sales volume in this warehouse.

outputParameters.name: ITTY
outputParameters.description: Item type determining the lifecycle and behavior of the item.

outputParameters.name: RESP
outputParameters.description: User responsible for this item or balance identity.

outputParameters.name: UNMS
outputParameters.description: Basic unit of measure in which all balances are expressed.

outputParameters.name: ITGR
outputParameters.description: Item group used to categorize the item.

outputParameters.name: PLCD
outputParameters.description: Planning policy controlling material planning for this item.

outputParameters.name: SLTP
outputParameters.description: Stock zone of the location for this balance identity.

outputParameters.name: WHLT
outputParameters.description: Location type grouping locations by characteristics such as size.

outputParameters.name: IDDT
outputParameters.description: Date when stock was last received for this balance identity.

outputParameters.name: ODDT
outputParameters.description: Date when stock was last issued from this balance identity.

outputParameters.name: INDT
outputParameters.description: Date when this balance identity was last included in a physical inventory.

outputParameters.name: INON
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether a physical inventory is currently in progress for this balance identity.

outputParameters.name: STAS
outputParameters.description: Status of the balance identity, such as under inspection, approved or rejected.

outputParameters.name: RCLS
outputParameters.description: Date when the lot for this balance identity is planned or was last reclassified.

outputParameters.name: PRDT
outputParameters.description: Priority date used to determine allocation order for this balance identity.

outputParameters.name: STQT
outputParameters.description: Approved on-hand balance quantity for this balance identity in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: PHSQ
outputParameters.description: Total on-hand balance for this balance identity in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: ALOC
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether this balance identity can be automatically allocated.

outputParameters.name: ALQT
outputParameters.description: Quantity allocated from this balance identity in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: PHAQ
outputParameters.description: Allocated quantity for this balance identity.

outputParameters.name: AUDE
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether this balance identity is subject to automatic deletion when balances reach zero.

outputParameters.name: AUDD
outputParameters.description: Number of days the balance identity is retained before automatic deletion when balances reach zero.

outputParameters.name: STAQ
outputParameters.description: Number of active physical inventory lines linked to this balance identity.

outputParameters.name: PHA2
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether an active physical inventory exists for this balance identity.

outputParameters.name: POCY
outputParameters.description: Normal potency used for planning and accounting for this item.

outputParameters.name: CAWE
outputParameters.description: Catch weight of the lot for this balance identity (deprecated).

outputParameters.name: LPCY
outputParameters.description: Actual potency of this lot expressed as a percentage.

outputParameters.name: PPUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure used for the purchase price of the item.

outputParameters.name: BREF
outputParameters.description: First lot reference used for additional identification or tracing of the lot.

outputParameters.name: PACT
outputParameters.description: Packaging ID describing how the item is packed for this balance identity.

outputParameters.name: BRE2
outputParameters.description: Second lot reference used for additional identification or tracing of the lot.

outputParameters.name: BREM
outputParameters.description: Free-text remark recorded for this balance identity.

outputParameters.name: REOP
outputParameters.description: Reorder point quantity that triggers planned replenishment for this item and warehouse.

outputParameters.name: ATNR
outputParameters.description: Attribute number controlling the attribute values used for this balance identity.

outputParameters.name: ATNB
outputParameters.description: Lot attribute number linked to this lot.

outputParameters.name: STAT
outputParameters.description: Overall status of the item or balance identity, such as preliminary, definite or blocked.

outputParameters.name: CAW2
outputParameters.description: Catch weight to be credited for this balance identity, for example on customer returns.

outputParameters.name: INDI
outputParameters.description: Lot control method indicating how lot numbers are managed for this item.

outputParameters.name: BACD
outputParameters.description: Lot numbering method used to create lot numbers for this item.

outputParameters.name: EXPD
outputParameters.description: Method used to calculate the expiration date and priority date for the lot.

outputParameters.name: ACTI
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the item is an active or catch weight item and how it is inspected.

outputParameters.name: ATMN
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the item is managed with attribute management and how attribute panels are used.

outputParameters.name: CWUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure in which catch weight is recorded for this item.

outputParameters.name: COMG
outputParameters.description: Method used to manage containers for this item in inventory.
